# Guide content and sources

- Keep explanations beginner-friendly, practical, and centered on building a living-room theater over time, improving Wi-Fi coverage, and enabling compatible home automation.
- Check `docs/sources/` for project research before editing. Attribute claims to supplied material or verify current claims from primary manufacturer documentation; distinguish reported/source wording from independently verified facts.
- State model, region, compatibility, and date limits where relevant. Do not turn compatibility possibilities into guarantees.
- Preserve the distinction between Alexa Home Theater audio, eero mesh networking, and eero Built-in Echo extension.
- Keep price discussion clearly labeled as user-supplied historical examples unless verified live; never invent unsupported specs or prices.
- If the user asks to capture conversation history, append the relevant user/assistant exchange to `docs/conversations/2026-10-04-home-theater-planning.md` without adding secrets or personal account/delivery details.
- Update directly related source documentation. Run focused tests when behavior changes; prose-only edits need no build.
